scripts.build: pnpm run clean && pnpm run build:esm && pnpm run build:umd && pnpm run build:types
scripts.start: pnpm run build:types && vite build --mode esm --watch
scripts.typecheck:source: pnpm run prepare:consumer && vue-tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && vue-tsc -p __test__/unit/tsconfig.json --noEmit && vue-tsc -p __test__/ui/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.typecheck:public: pnpm run build && pnpm run typecheck:public:built
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:source && pnpm run typecheck:public
scripts.test:ui: pnpm run build && pnpm run test:ui:built
scripts.test: pnpm run build && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck:source && pnpm run typecheck:public:built && pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:ui:built
